pages.text: Obtained by altering a Goat Horn, War Horns can not only  be tooted, but can also be imbibed with potions to apply their effects on all pets and people nearby whenever blown. The duration of said effects  is half as long as the original potion. The imbibed horn does not lose its effects after use but filling it with a second potion can overwrite them.

By crafting together a Blood Feather, an Echo Pearl and a War Horn at a Smithing Table, a Hex Horn will be obtained that can apply its imbibed potion effects onto all enemies nearby. Both horn types can be enchanted with Power, to increase their range, and Quick Charge to decrease their usage cooldown. Hex Horns

additionally support the Flame enchantment, making it so the victims will also be set on fire alongside the respective potion effects. The power of the horns can be further amplified by wearing an $(l:armors/ivory_crown)$(c)$(o)Ivory Crown$().
